title: CONCEPT – An Evaluation Protocol on Conversational Recommender Systems with System-centric and User-centric Factors
reasoning: The paper's evaluation protocol, CONCEPT, incorporates 'Sincerity' as a core primary ability under its 'Social Intelligence' factor.
